notes: Fixed means nominal TARGET physics only; robot gains, hand friction, launch and observation/control noise remain in the main range experiment.
The separate nominal_robot test fixes PID multipliers and disables observation/control noise; it does not disable every possible environment randomization.
Per-object samples are small (20); these inference tests do not establish benefits of retraining under smaller ranges.
Explicit initial-state seeds are matched; later noise is not strictly paired because historical synchronous envs share a global NumPy RNG.
